cases.sentence: Он был больше Гая, и все его жители были ___.
cases.explain: «храбрыми воинами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Now when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them,

cases.sentence: Пять ___ — царей Иерусалима, Хеврона, Ярмута, Лахиша и Эглона — объединили силы.
cases.explain: «аморрейских царей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together and went up, they and all their armies, and encamped against Gibeon, and made war against it.

cases.sentence: Тогда гаваонитяне послали сказать Иисусу в ___:
cases.explain: «гилгалский лагерь» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Don’t abandon your servants! Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us; for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us.”

cases.sentence: Когда они бежали от израильтян по склону Бет-Хорона в Азеку, Господь забросал их с неба ___, и от каменного града погибло больше народа, чем от мечей израильтян.
cases.explain: «огромными градинами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the sky on them to Azekah, and they died. There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.

cases.sentence: Когда они бежали от израильтян по склону Бет-Хорона в Азеку, Господь забросал их с неба огромными градинами, и от ___ погибло больше народа, чем от мечей израильтян.
cases.explain: «каменного града» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the sky on them to Azekah, and they died. There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.

cases.sentence: После этого Иисус вернулся со всем Израилем в ___.
cases.explain: «гилгалский лагерь» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

cases.sentence: Ко входу в пещеру привалили ___, которые там и по сегодняшний день.
cases.explain: «большие камни» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: At the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and threw them into the cave in which they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.

cases.sentence: Ко входу в пещеру привалили большие камни, которые там и по ___.
cases.explain: «сегодняшний день» — after the preposition «по», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: At the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and threw them into the cave in which they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.

cases.sentence: Господь отдал Лахиш Израилю, и Иисус взял его на ___.
cases.explain: «второй день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Yahweh delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel. He took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with all the souls who were in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

cases.sentence: Затем Иисус и весь Израиль с ним вернулись в ___.
cases.explain: «гилгалский лагерь» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.
